name: event-grid
description: Event routing service for reactive event-driven architectures

defaultConfig.note: Pay per event — first 100K events/month free, then $0.60/million. Use for decoupled event-driven communication between services.

integration.authNote: Use DefaultAzureCredential with EventGrid Data Sender role. Topic endpoint URL is all you need — no access keys.

sdkInitPattern.python:
from azure.eventgrid import EventGridPublisherClient
from azure.core.messaging import CloudEvent
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
client = EventGridPublisherClient(
    endpoint=os.environ['AZURE_EVENT_GRID_TOPIC_ENDPOINT'],
    credential=credential
)

event = CloudEvent(
    type='com.myapp.order.created',
    source='/orders',
    data={'orderId': '123', 'amount': 99.99}
)
client.send([event])

healthCheck.python: # No lightweight health check — Event Grid validates on first publish
healthCheck.description: Publish a test event with type 'com.myapp.health.check'

receiverPattern.note: Event Grid pushes events to subscribers (webhooks, Functions, Service Bus). The receiver side is typically an HTTP endpoint that validates the subscription handshake.
